note.zh: RM50 订金将从治疗费用中扣除。

knowledge: Dentists: Dr. Farah (general & cosmetic) and Dr. Kevin Tan (braces). Patients may request a dentist; staff will confirm availability.
Parking: free parking in front of the shoplot and along Jalan SS2/24; weekday lunch hours are busy.
Payment: cash, debit/credit card, DuitNow QR, Touch 'n Go eWallet. We are not a panel clinic for any insurer; we issue an itemised receipt for patients to claim themselves.
Children are welcome; the clinic sees children from age 3. A parent must accompany anyone under 18.
Scaling: usually 30 minutes, usually painless; mild sensitivity for a day or two afterwards is normal. Recommended every 6 months.
Fillings and extractions are done under local anaesthetic; numbness lasts 2–3 hours. Avoid hot food until it wears off.
Teeth whitening is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Routine check-ups and scaling are safe during pregnancy; we avoid X-rays in the first trimester unless urgent.
Braces consultation is free. Metal braces from RM4,500; clear aligners from RM8,000; instalment plans available, ask staff.
We provide a medical certificate (MC) for treatments that need rest, at the dentist's discretion.
Walk-ins are accepted when there is a free slot but booked patients are seen first.
Languages at the counter: Bahasa Melayu, English, Mandarin, Cantonese.
Emergencies (severe pain, swelling of the face, knocked-out tooth): call the clinic immediately during opening hours; after hours go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
Chinese-speaking patients are welcome; Dr. Kevin Tan speaks Mandarin and Cantonese.
